stem:
Kabir needs equal intervals of time for a class activity and has no clock.

Which processes can be used to measure time? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: A pendulum that swings with a steady repeating beat.
Water drops from a tap that fall at equal repeating intervals.
Handclaps made at random with no steady beat.
A single shout that happens only once.

teacher.key_rationale: A repeating steady process can mark equal time intervals. Random claps and a one-off shout cannot.
